strengths: The runtime delta is bounded to six files and preserves existing Matter, Item Graph, persistence, authority, and network foundations.
P7.4 composes existing MW5 Matter recovery and existing M6/V0 gameplay recovery instead of introducing a P7-private persistence repository or save format.
The accepted P7.3 MatterMaterialBatch -> canonical Item Graph coordinator is reused directly; no second delivery path or receipt ledger is introduced.
Recovered MW4 replay is checked against the persisted COMMITTED result and additionally fenced by receiver hash, journal hash, and batch-count equality.
The aggregate gameplay revision defect was fixed in the existing NetworkedGameplayService owner, under a canonical Work Order amendment, rather than hidden inside a P7-private revision counter.
The aggregate revision seam is replay-aware: successful fresh canonical output advances once, while canonical replay does not advance.
The focused acceptance is a real three-process sequence using durable user:// state with separate seed, recover-deliver, and recover-replay invocations.

findings.summary: Initial restart delivery changed the canonical Item Graph without advancing the enclosing NetworkedGameplayService authoritative revision, producing SAME_REVISION_AUTHORITATIVE_MUTATION.
findings.resolution: A canonical P7.4 Work Order amendment authorized the existing NetworkedGameplayService path. Final HEAD delegates server-output preflight/apply to the canonical Item Graph and calls _advance() exactly once only after successful non-replay output.

findings.summary: The new aggregate revision seam wraps canonical Item Graph mutation and aggregate _advance() in one synchronous call, but the two owners still expose separate internal revisions.
findings.resolution: Reviewer must verify there is no alternate P7.4 path that can bypass the wrapper, no failure/replay path advances the aggregate, and the existing single-threaded synchronous call boundary is sufficient for the current persistence model.

findings.summary: The restart-focused seed constructs one valid committed MW5 state through public canonical MW4 contracts and receiver/journal rather than executing full excavation geometry in the seed process.
findings.resolution: The full P7.4 runner separately preserves the real P7.3 LunarMatterBubble -> MW4 -> Item Graph regression. Reviewer must explicitly judge whether this separation is valid for the P7.4 persistence/restart boundary or whether a full real-excavation seed is required.

findings.summary: The Implementer container did not freshly complete every canonical regression stage: P7.2 bubble, MW4 and MW6 are not promoted as fresh PASS, and M6 recovery processes exceeded the 180-second execution window.
findings.resolution: No assertion RED is being reclassified. Fresh independent Ubuntu Verifier must execute the complete canonical P7.4 gate and is the only actor allowed to close these gaps.

bounded_questions.unnecessary_complexity: The separate authoritative Item Graph output port is a small stateless adapter that keeps P7.4 from calling NetworkedGameplayService internals directly and makes aggregate-revision ownership explicit. Removing it would couple the restart coordinator directly to the aggregate service surface.
bounded_questions.duplicate_truth: None intended. Matter durability remains MW5-owned, gameplay durability remains M6/V0-owned, Item Graph exactly-once remains canonical Item Graph-owned, and aggregate revision remains NetworkedGameplayService-owned.
bounded_questions.implicit_owner: No new durable owner. P7.4 objects hold runtime references only; all persisted state is delegated to existing repositories/coordinators.
bounded_questions.coupling_reduction: The only cross-domain coupling added to NetworkedGameplayService is the Work Order-approved canonical server-output wrapper. P7.4 otherwise depends on public recovery/service methods.
bounded_questions.sibling_surface_fix: P3 aggregate recovery and M6 recovery contracts were freshly rerun on exact frozen source; the fresh Verifier still owns complete sibling closure.
bounded_questions.removable_code: No previous runtime owner or persistence path is replaced or bypassed.
bounded_questions.design_regression: The primary design question is test-boundary realism, not owner structure: whether contract-built committed MW5 seed state plus separate real P7.3 regression is sufficient evidence for restart composition.
bounded_questions.refactor_if_redesigned: If future gameplay persistence exposes a first-class atomic domain-output transaction, move the aggregate-revision coupling behind that canonical transaction rather than adding any P7-local transaction or receipt state.

open_blockers: Fresh independent Verifier after Reviewer PASS.
nonblocking_followups: P7.5 must prove two-client convergence using accepted P7.4 restart semantics.
P7.7 must compose the accepted chain into the graphical equip-aim-dig-material-inventory product slice.
